column1: # Attempts to make the proof lane pass without a real proof. Each is applied to the
# proof sources (exact text -> replacement, `\n` for newlines) and must be rejected
# by the named gate: `proof` (does not compile), `audit` (compiles, audit rejects)
# or `kernel` (passes the audit, the kernel replay rejects).

    (Lean.mkConst ``True.intro) [`AeneasV1.Refinement.forged]))
